verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that a named Bot keeps its memory, files, browser sessions, and preferences across sessions instead of resetting, and that Bots share context in group chats. Two hands-on community users independently describe each bot owning its own context and 'seamless memory'. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how memory is stored and how relevant context is selected and applied in new chats, user controls to view/edit/delete memories, and clarity on whether memory carries across different Bots (it appears scoped per Bot).
